prompts.tree_01: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production tree canopy sprite for a top-down WW2 European strategy boardgame. Strict vertical overhead orthographic camera, looking straight down at the crown. Mature European deciduous tree in SUMMER, olive green and warm sage with pale yellow-green sunlit leaf edges. Fine, carefully drawn SMALL foliage clusters, subtle distinct leaf shapes, a few slender dark branching veins visible between clusters. Clear light-dark separation at cluster boundaries; matching the fine, crisp detail density of a snowy winter tree sprite. Hand-painted naturalistic strategy map illustration, matte, warm upper-left light, restrained depth; no photorealistic gloss and no broad blurry foliage blobs. A neat irregular leafy silhouette, crown covers about 88% of the square, centered with enough margin to keep ALL foliage inside. Truly transparent background including gaps between outer leaves; no ground, no grass disk, no trunk sticking below the crown, no cast shadow outside the foliage, no sky, no snow, no text, no border, no sheet. Crucial: recognizable and crisp even when reduced to 30-50 pixels. Broad rounded oak crown, balanced but naturally lobed, roughly circular.
